entities.summary: Andreas Kalbitz is a German politician and former member of the Alternative for Germany (AfD) party. He was a member of the party from 2013 until his expulsion in 2020. From 2017 to 2020, he served as chairman of the AfD Brandenburg faction of the party in the Landtag of Brandenburg, a state parliament.
